name: SRH Hochschule Berlin
description:
Are you looking to study at a university that offers Bachelor's, Master's and MBA programs focussing on management and technology? Then, the SRH Berlin University of Applied Sciences has got you covered.

Whether you want to do an internship or work on a research project, the University ensures the right path for every educational goal.

Notably, the SRH Berlin University of Applied Sciences offers a place where people not just build their careers, but also love to learn and explore.

About the University

The SRH Berlin University of Applied Sciences offers more than 80 accredited German and English programs in various fields like entrepreneurship, technology and IT, and media and creative industries. The University also provides study programs in music, design, film and text.

Its management programs (MBA + DBA) focus on personal development, responsible business solutions and economic feasibility. Also, the University provides dual programs that combine academic education and relevant work experience. 

The SRH Berlin University of Applied Sciences maintains eight schools in five cities, including Berlin, Dresden, Hamburg, Leipzig, and Stuttgart. With state-of-the-art facilities, the University no longer prioritises lecture-based teaching.

Why choose the SRH Berlin University of Applied Sciences?

Dedicated to the search for new knowledge, the SRH Berlin University of Applied Sciences is working to facilitate a change of perspective. Here's why you should enrol at the University:

  • It will translate your passion into a career. 
  • The University believes in hands-on learning in small teams, step-by-step skill acquisition and individual support from lecturers. Personal learning coaches will also help you improve your soft and hard skills. 
  • It offers bachelor’s (48 programs), master’s (30 programs) and short-term courses in a range of modern subjects like creative industries management, user experience design and content creation.
  • It maintains campuses in popular German cities like Berlin, Dresden and Hamburg.
  • It has a large international community. 

Student life

You will get a global exposure at SRH, as you meet staff and students from over 90 nations.

You can also enjoy facilities like a library, and chill-out areas like the terrace and inner courtyards at the Berlin campus.

Besides, the University organises workshops, informative events, application training and interview coaching at the Berlin, Dresden and Hamburg campuses.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
While studying at the SRH Berlin University of Applied Sciences, you can choose to either stay with flatmates or live by yourself. If you're studying at Berlin, Dresden or Hamburg, then hotels, hostels and short-term rentals will be available. You can also opt for a room, shared apartment or student residence.

Additionally, the University suggests that you must register yourself as a resident of the city within 14 days of moving in.

highlights.title: Sports
highlights.value: A member of the Allgemeiner Deutscher Hochschulsportverband, the University allows you to participate in various sports activities. You can also avail of sports offers provided by other member universities in Berlin. At the Dresden campus, you can use the sports offers of TU-Dresden, such as exercise and relaxation courses, short exercise programs, strengthening, and stretching.

highlights.title: Lab
highlights.value:
The SRH Berlin University of Applied Sciences maintains a start-up lab, an open, cross-school meeting space. Here, you will get opportunities to develop your entrepreneurial personality in an interdisciplinary environment. You will get to exchange ideas, work, learn, experiment, relax and celebrate together. The start-up lab not only helps you start your business but also expands your network.

Also, the campus at Berlin features four engineering labs to broaden and deepen your expertise.
